objective: Win one paid technical article assignment using L & N's existing browser-audio implementation and tests, without creating speculative full content or implying a commissioned article.

source_need.title: Writing A Smashing Article
source_need.published_compensation: Honorarium paid on publication; no numerical fee is published in the reviewed guidelines.
source_need.published_process: Pitch an original article with audience, takeaway, relevant experience, writing samples, and a 200–300-word outline. An editor decides topic fit before the full draft.
source_need.editorial_boundary: Individual authors and practical technical lessons, not product tours, hidden advertising, affiliate promotion, or a corporate press release. Assistance policy and exact commercial terms still need confirmation.

fit.proposed_title: When Play Does Nothing: Building Cancellable Audio in a React PWA
fit.audience: JavaScript and React developers adding short audio sequences or microphone practice to web applications
supported_now: Web Audio playback with bounded startup and a reusable media-element fallback
Whole-file word clips, decoded-buffer reuse, and longer spacing between identical words
Twenty passing focused tests across word-audio, audio-capture, and speech
fit.claim_boundary: Project-owned source and focused mocked tests support the pitch. They do not establish all-device compatibility, clinical accuracy, reader outcomes, customer delivery, or prior Smashing publication.

application.method: One reviewed submission through the ordinary official contact form under Become an author, using the maintainer name, business reply address, two public proof links, and a 242-word outline.
application.delivery_evidence: After one Send action, the same page displayed Thank you! and confirmed receipt of the form submission. A separate read verified the confirmation without resubmission; navigation response status was 200.
application.exact_content_storage: Ignored private application note and screenshots
application.acceptance_gate: Before drafting or accepting work, confirm topic, author and assistance eligibility, exact fee and currency, payment route and timing, length, deadline, rights, revision limit, and acceptance terms.
